epic.title: In-App Messaging & Trade Chat
epic.description: Add real-time channel-based chat so users can discuss trades and market ideas without leaving the TradeEasy app. Includes live ticker card sharing, content moderation, and MiFID II-compliant message retention.
epic.businessValue: Closes the context-switching gap between external trading communities (Discord, WhatsApp) and trade execution. Users who engage with social features have 3.1× higher 90-day retention; message-to-trade conversion target is 8% within 10 minutes of reading a message.
epic.prdLink: PRD: In-App Messaging & Trade Chat — TradeEasy

features.title: Channel Management
features.description: Users can create, join, and leave topic-based trading channels with persistent membership.

stories.title: Browse and join a public channel
stories.goal: find and join a channel dedicated to a stock I'm watching
stories.benefit: so that I can follow live discussions about that ticker without leaving TradeEasy
acceptanceCriteria: Given I open the Chat tab, When the channel list loads, Then I see public channels sorted by recent activity, each showing: name, topic, and member count
Given I tap a channel I haven't joined, When I tap 'Join', Then I am added as a member and the channel thread is displayed immediately
Given I am already a member of a channel, When I open the Chat tab, Then my joined channels appear at the top of the list with an unread badge if there are new messages

stories.title: Create a new public channel
stories.goal: create a topic channel for a ticker or theme that doesn't exist yet
stories.benefit: so that I can seed a community around a stock or strategy I follow
acceptanceCriteria: Given I tap 'New Channel', When I enter a name and topic and tap 'Create', Then the channel is created, I am auto-joined as the founder, and the channel appears in the list immediately
Given I enter a channel name that already exists, When I tap 'Create', Then an inline error 'A channel with this name already exists' is shown and no duplicate is created
Given I enter a channel name containing a blocked keyword, When I tap 'Create', Then an inline error is shown and the channel is not created

constraints: Channel name must be lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, max 32 chars

stories.title: Leave a channel
stories.goal: leave channels I no longer follow to reduce noise
stories.benefit: so that my channel list stays relevant to my current interests
acceptanceCriteria: Given I am a member of a channel, When I tap 'Leave Channel' in the channel settings, Then I am removed from the channel and it no longer appears in my joined list
Given I leave a channel and return to the channel list, When I search for the channel, Then it appears in the public list with an option to rejoin

constraints: Leaving a channel does not delete message history

features.title: Real-time Text Messaging
features.description: Users can send and receive text messages in channels with sub-second latency during market hours.

stories.title: Send and receive text messages in a channel
stories.goal: type a message and have it appear in the channel thread for all members instantly
stories.benefit: so that I can share trade ideas and react to market moves in real time
acceptanceCriteria: Given I am in a channel thread, When I type a message and press Enter or tap Send, Then my message appears in the thread within 500ms
Given another member sends a message to a channel I am viewing, When the message arrives, Then it appears at the bottom of my thread without requiring a page refresh
Given I send a message exceeding 2,000 characters, When I tap Send, Then an inline counter shows 'Over limit — 2,000 character maximum' and the message is not sent
Given I send messages faster than 30 per minute, When the rate limit is reached, Then I see a toast 'Slow down — you're sending messages too quickly' and further sends are blocked for 10 seconds

constraints: WebSocket write-through to Cassandra before fan-out; no message loss on pod restart

stories.title: Share a live ticker card in a message
stories.goal: attach a live price card for a stock I'm discussing so other members can see the exact price and act on it immediately
stories.benefit: so that I don't have to copy-paste prices and members can tap through to trade
acceptanceCriteria: Given I am composing a message, When I tap the ticker-card icon and search for a symbol, Then I can select a symbol and a ticker card is attached to my message draft showing current price and change
Given a message with a ticker card is displayed in the thread, When I view it, Then the card shows the symbol, current price, and intraday % change updated within 15 seconds
Given I tap a ticker card in a message, When the tap registers, Then I am taken to the TradeEasy instrument detail screen for that symbol
Given the market is closed, When I view a ticker card, Then it displays the previous close price with a 'Market Closed' label

constraints: Ticker card price updates subscribe to existing Market Data Service WS feed; 15s update interval
technical.apiChanges: WS: send with tickerRef: { symbol }; server resolves live price

stories.title: Load message history on channel open
stories.goal: see recent messages when I open a channel even if I wasn't connected when they were sent
stories.benefit: so that I can catch up on discussion and context before contributing
acceptanceCriteria: Given I open a channel, When the thread renders, Then the last 50 messages are displayed within 1 second
Given I scroll to the top of the loaded history, When I reach the oldest loaded message, Then older messages are loaded in batches of 50 without losing scroll position
Given a channel has no messages, When I open it, Then an empty state is shown: 'No messages yet — start the conversation'

constraints: Cursor-based pagination using (channel_id, created_at) composite key in Cassandra

features.title: Live Ticker Card Sharing
features.description: Users can embed live-updating ticker price cards directly into any message.

stories.title: Attach ticker card from instrument screen
stories.goal: share a ticker card while discussing a stock so others see live price
stories.benefit: so that I can reference specific price points and enable quick trades
acceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing an instrument detail screen, When I tap 'Share to Chat', Then I see a sheet to select a channel
Given I select a channel, When the sheet closes, Then I return to the channel thread with a ticker card attached to my message draft
Given a ticker card is attached, When I send the message, Then the card renders inline with the symbol, current price, and % change

constraints: Card subscribes to market data feed; updates every 15s during market hours

stories.title: Ticker card updates in real time
stories.goal: see live price updates on ticker cards in messages
stories.benefit: so that I know the current price when deciding whether to trade
acceptanceCriteria: Given a ticker card is displayed in a message, When the price changes, Then the card updates within 15 seconds during market hours
Given the market is closed, When I view a ticker card, Then it shows the previous close with a 'Market Closed' label
Given I tap a ticker card, When it opens, Then I navigate to the instrument detail screen pre-filled with a buy order

constraints: WebSocket subscription to quotes:{symbol} Redis channel
